quotes.text: They are all good, we have another training session this afternoon, so we are really positive about everybody.

We have so many players injured. It’s difficult to mention every one. Marco [Bizot] is out, [Amadou] Onana, [Modou Kéba] Cisse out, Pau [Torres], [Ian] Maatsen out, [Leon] Goretzka out, [Brian] Madjo out. I think that’s enough. The other players are ready.
I think it’s more or less the same as the other night, yeah. So, nothing has really changed on that front.
He’s [Luka Vuskovic] young, he will recover fast. He definitely will be an option for tomorrow.
In terms of injuries, and in terms of the squad, we are having the last training session tomorrow, so no one is ruled out for us for Friday.
He’s [Aurele Amenda] got a calf injury and he’ll be scanned over the next 24 hours or so. I would expect not available, yeah.
It’s the same situation. He’s not with the team for the moment… We expect him [Ismaïla Sarr] next Monday to start training with the first team.
Merlin Röhl is not available yet, hopefully he’ll be ready at the end of the international break.
He’s [Nobel Mendy] in the concussion protocol. So, seven days off, and after this, he will go to the national team.
Everyone is ready to go. We are in the same place we were, the three long-term injuries plus Federico.
Probably he [Jeremy Doku] can be available for Sunderland.
There is kind of a chance on both of them [Luke Shaw and Carlos Baleba], really. Not totally 100 per cent yet but there’s half a chance.
Amar [Dedic] will be also not able to play on Saturday.
Nikola [Milenkovic], not [available]… But Jair [Cunha] trained with us today… looks okay.
Porro, Tonali, Maddison, all are available to play.
